The full auto-cadence (conductor + rot-canary) now runs on Antigravity 2.0's real hook engine, not just Claude Code — pilot-proven to fire live on AG, but injected-context delivery into the agent is not yet validated end-to-end.

### Added
- The 3 Node hooks are now dual-mode via an event-name argument (Claude Code invokes with none — zero CC behavior change): the conductor rides the first `PreInvocation` of a session, guarded once-per-session by a temp marker written before the emit; the stop hook emits `additionalContext` JSON on AG instead of a block decision; the touch hook reads AG's payload shapes defensively. KIND 1 self-update stays deliberately Claude-Code-only (an AG-side check would consume the CC throttle stamp); the KIND 2 rule-freshness nudge rides along. `platform-configs/hooks/antigravity-hooks.json` rewritten to the verified AG spec.
- +6 hermetic AG spawn tests (92 total).

### Fixed
- `skills/rot-canary/references/cadence.md`'s stale pre-2.0 Antigravity description replaced with the real story: the `hooks.json` engine, its three event names, and the dual-mode event-name argument.

body:
The two-level config cascade lands, bringing CoalMine to key-parity with its four siblings.

### Added
- Every hook now reads `~/.claude/.coalmine.json` and overlays it per key with the project `<gitroot>/.coalmine.json` (project wins). Either file alone works; keys named `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` are dropped at merge so an untrusted project config cannot pollute the prototype. Shipped in the shared config partial, so all three Node hooks and both PowerShell twins gain it in one place.
- `configure.mjs --global` now targets the global layer (`~/.claude/.coalmine.json`, directory created if missing) instead of the project git-root file.

### Changed
- README's Configure intro updated from "there is no global layer" to describe the two-level cascade, naming the `--global` writer.

The previous wording implied the flock's two-level cascade, which this repo's code did not implement.

body:
Two HIGH-severity fixes (a SessionStart ReDoS and a CI test-gate hole), one doc-accuracy MED, and three LOW polish fixes — all reproduced independently by two parallel board audits.

### Fixed
- [HIGH] The SessionStart gold-rule scan was O(n²) on a poisoned rules file — a rules `.md` with many unterminated `<!-- coalmine: verified` openers made each opener's match walk to end of file (measured ~9.2s at 2MB), which could hang session start on a cloned/untrusted repo. Fixed by bounding each opener's match to a 2048-char window, mirroring the same fix already shipped in `consistency.mjs` — linear over the file (~0.47s at 2MB).
- [HIGH] CI's test gate had no missing-file guard — a hardcoded file list passed to `node --test` let a missing test file be silently reinterpreted as a zero-match filter on Node 24, so a renamed or deleted test could drop out of the `main` gate without failing it. A new guarded test runner (`scripts/test.mjs`) now backs CI and both git hooks, so the test list lives in exactly one place.
- [MED] `PRIVACY.md` claimed hooks write only to the OS temp directory and session markers — it did not disclose the conductor's persistent update-check stamp or rot-canary's mode/opt-out file reads under `~/.claude/`. Corrected.
- [LOW] The `disabledCanaries` doc example listed a skill-canary as mechanically disable-able when the key only honors it advisorily for that class — reworded.
- [LOW] `commands/stats.md` said it delivers two sections; it delivers three. Corrected.
- [LOW] A dead sub-expression in the rot-canary merge-conflict tripwire regex, unreachable given an earlier check in the same condition, was removed.

### Notes
- The ReDoS fix and the CI gate hole were both confirmed by independent hermetic timing/reproduction, not by assertion. No `plugin/` runtime capability was added — this is a bug-fix and gate-hardening release.

Gold-standard gains an interactive setup wizard — manual `/gold-standard` only; the auto/keyword path is unchanged and pays nothing for it.

### Added
- `gold-standard/references/wizard.md`, read on-demand when a user runs `/gold-standard` manually. Layman path (bare `/gold-standard` or "audit my rules"): the AI picks safe defaults (relevant dimensions from one cheap scan, Standard tier, AUDIT), then asks one plain question — go / go deeper (also fill the gaps) / cancel. Programmer path (`advanced` or `ACTION=`): one batched question (act, dimensions, tier), the bill computed from the picks, then go/change/cancel.
- A one-line manual-entry pointer added to `gold-standard/SKILL.md`; the always-resident body and the cheap auto/keyword path are unchanged.

### Notes
- The wizard's tier question folds into the resident escalation footer's existing tier-pick rather than asking twice — no duplicate round-trip.

Gate: build + 69 node tests + consistency + verify PASS.

Config-clamp hardening from a board-audit round — behavior unchanged for any valid config.

### Fixed
- rot-canary's stop hook now clamps `autoScanFileCap`/`autoScanFileCapSlice` at read time: `0` no longer emits an empty-list "capped at 0" nudge, and `-1` no longer silently drops the last touched file. The PowerShell twin clamps identically, restoring Node/PowerShell parity.
- `updateCheckDays` now validates as an integer between 1 and 365 (previously only a lower bound of 1 was enforced, so `1.5` or `99999` were accepted) — matches CoalBoard and CoalTipple.

Gate: build + 69 node tests + consistency + verify PASS.

body:
Board-audit fixes from a whole-repo review (28 of 139 raised findings confirmed; the rest false-positive, by-design, or over-hardening) — bugfixes only, no canary behavior change.

### Fixed
- The PowerShell config-parity test is now gated in pre-commit and pre-push (skips if `pwsh` is absent, fails loud when present) — closes a gap where a PowerShell-side regression could ship silently.
- A new consistency check fails if the hand-duplicated JSONC comment-stripper regex in `jsonc.mjs` and `node-config.js` ever diverge.
- rot-canary's merge-conflict tripwire no longer false-positives on a bare `=======` banner (it now requires a co-occurring real conflict marker), and its `>maxLines` check no longer misfires on a file sitting exactly at the cap.
- The 5 platform hook-config templates now quote the node script path, so a path containing spaces is no longer word-split.
- The scale/telemetry/testability/drift canaries' "Apply safe fixes" bullets now carry the same checkpoint → build/test → revert-if-red guard the other canaries already had.
- `install.mjs`'s default-config warning path is now fail-loud instead of silent. README's Configuration-Schema table is completed to all 23 keys (was 6). The issue template's agent dropdown gains Antigravity.

### Notes
- Erratum to the `[3.7.8]` entry: its "dropped the scrapped Antigravity entry" wording over-scoped — the removal was limited to one reference table, and the always-resident footer still names Antigravity correctly. Antigravity remains a fully-supported install target.

Gate: build + 64 node tests + consistency (+ the new JSONC-sync check) + verify PASS.

body:
PowerShell-parity fixes and doc/config accuracy corrections, found by a CoalBoard dogfood audit.

### Fixed
- PowerShell hooks now enforce the same `session_id` sandbox allowlist as the Node twins, closing a path where a traversal-shaped session ID could escape the temp directory.
- The PowerShell JSONC stripper is now string-aware like its Node counterpart — previously, a legal inline `// comment` in `.coalmine.json` silently voided the entire file on PowerShell hooks (Node honored it correctly).
- `config-schema.mjs`'s integer validation now enforces `Number.isInteger` plus min/max bounds on every int key, rejecting degenerate values like a negative `tempSweepStaleDays`.
- PowerShell/Node parity: `.touched` dedup now lowercases on win32 matching Node, and a scalar `"all"` from `ConvertFrom-Json` no longer fails to disable a canary.

### Changed
- `SECURITY.md`'s scan-provenance comment synced to its prose.
- The scrapped "Antigravity" entry dropped from the orchestration escalation footer and the issue-template dropdown; the unverifiable "Windsurf (now Devin)" attribution removed.

### Removed
- A stray root `.coalmine.json` — the maintainer's own tuned machine config, tracked at the repo root since v3.7.1 by mistake. Config is create-if-absent, and `platform-configs/.coalmine.json` is the shipped template; no project-level config ships.
